description: DB server scan: Linux infra (kisa_all_check --only infra; now safe after U-26 /dev fix) + Oracle DBMS (run INSIDE the Oracle container via docker exec, in-container OS auth / as sysdba, no password). Produces server_linux_* (infra) and db_oracle_* (DBMS) and uploads both to S3 results/.

S3Base.description: S3 base prefix (tools/ and results/ live under it).

Container.description: Name of the running Oracle Docker container on the DB host.

runCommand: if ! command -v aws >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '[!] aws CLI not available on this host'; exit 1; fi
aws s3 cp {{S3Base}}/tools/kisa_all_check.ps1 kisa_all_check.ps1 || { echo '[!] download kisa_all_check failed'; exit 1; }
timeout 600 bash kisa_all_check.ps1 --only infra -o scan; echo "[*] infra rc=$? (124=timeout, else ignore)"
echo '[*] (2/2) oracle scan inside container {{Container}} (OS auth / as sysdba)...'

if ! command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1 || [ -z "$(docker ps -q -f name={{Container}})" ]; then echo '[!] docker/container {{Container}} not available - skipping oracle'; else aws s3 cp {{S3Base}}/tools/db_oracle_check.sh db_oracle_check.sh && timeout 300 docker exec -i {{Container}} bash -s -- --csv /tmp/dbout.csv < db_oracle_check.sh; echo "[*] oracle rc=$? (124=timeout, else ignore)"; TS=$(date +%Y%m%d_%H%M); if docker cp {{Container}}:/tmp/dbout.csv "scan/db_oracle_db_${TS}.csv" 2>/dev/null; then HOSTIP=$(hostname -I 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $1}'); [ -n "$HOSTIP" ] && sed -i "s|^# ip,.*|# ip,$HOSTIP|" "scan/db_oracle_db_${TS}.csv" 2>/dev/null || true; docker exec {{Container}} rm -f /tmp/dbout.csv 2>/dev/null || true; else echo '[!] no oracle CSV produced from container'; fi; fi
ls scan/*.csv >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo '[!] no CSV produced'; exit 1; }
aws s3 cp scan/ {{S3Base}}/results/ --recursive --exclude '*' --include '*.csv' || { echo '[!] S3 upload failed - check IAM s3:PutObject'; exit 1; }
